inline_sha256.note: Includes SOURCE_SHA256; these two references identify a parent exported text, not a firmware image. No inline hash does not imply absence of external source manifests.

method.base_search: All 0x1000-aligned nonnegative bases with at least one complete row potentially in the candidate image; no signature/filename filter
method.exclusions: Non-page-aligned, relocated, packed, alternative encodings or absent image targets are not resolved by this test.
method.normalization: 2-byte raw unchanged; second halfword of 4-byte serialized row byte-swapped, matching original exporter convention
method.outside_window: Numeric address-window exclusion only; host/AP origin not established by filename.
method.selection: Prefer all-row-exact candidates; otherwise retain every supported candidate. Unique means unique in these nine files under this policy, not proof of original provenance.
method.small_exports: Fewer than 6 rows or 16 total bytes are insufficient, even if bytes match.
method.supported_candidate: At least 6 rows, >=95% matching rows, >=16 contiguous matching bytes, base in [0x08000000,0x08100000)
method.unresolved: No supported candidate is a bounded negative result, not proof of a missing build.
